notes.title: About now, past and the future
notes.content:
As said on twitter, I've been working really hard lately on the game, and I came to realization that I've been late with the game for almost full 6 months.

I really want to apologize to people who purchased game, for the drama on reddit threads, and my irresponsibility.

As of today, I am waiting on Steam support to enable package again so I could upload the 1.5 version of the game, somewhat of release but I can say it is a big step forward.

[h1]The update includes the following:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Full controller support (Steam controller, Xbox, Dual Shocks)
[*] Fully polished character controls
[*] Fixed stuttering
[*] AI seeking reworked
[*] 3 out of 7 bosses
[*] 5 out of 12 areas
[*] New artwork
[/list]

[b]TBD[/b]
[list]
[*] Soundtrack
[*] Voice acting
[*] Ability to control AI spawn through chat spam (hard capped at 20 so it doesn't go out of control, most of those ai will be timed explosions due to a fact that we all know how hard can twitch chat spam).
[*] Multiplayer
[/list]

[h1]What are my goals with this game?[/h1]

Well I honestly want to make something worth playing, so expect mixture of Hollow Knight and Celeste but with a twist. 

I also want to make somewhat of template for future games, because I do not want to stop here.

[h1]The drama part[/h1]
It is way too complicated, there were mistakes and miscommunication between both parties. 

There were supposed to be legal issues but I have decided not to follow up with that because it'd cause even more drama.

I do not want to say that it was all designers fault, it was more mine than his.

I have simply approached in the wrong way, which is kinda what I always do with people, I'd rather have friendly relationship than fucking so called "corporate" approach with a stick up in my butt.

If you are interested and want to know more please consider emailing me or sending me discord message.

Email:
kkona@infinitegachi.com
Discord:
.sh#4840

[h1]So when is the update coming?[/h1]

[b]3rd October of 2019.
I need to update store page with stuff and complete trailer which is kinda boring to do.[/b]

notes.title: Update #21424
notes.content:
During talks with steam support we have decided to remove game from store until the proper build is there.

All people who purchased/prepurchased still have access to the game.

Lots of updates are coming and most importantly the art is being changed.

I spoke to person who did art and we found some common ground for it and decided not to roll with pixel art.

Game will be on 70% discount when we republish it.

To keep track of updates and future development consider joining [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/PtFteJt]game discord server[/url].

Sorry for all inconvenience!

P.S. Alpha test achievement will be removed at 00:00 CEST (2 hours from now) so login if you haven't got it yet.
